notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
[h3] Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Wiped leaderboard due to significant gameplay changes.
[*] Added a pre-strafe speed cap of 7.50 u/s.
[*] Increased the start zone size to allow for easier pre-strafes.
[*] Improved the replay format to show the player shooting and hitting targets.
[*] Added third person animations to the leaderboard ghost's.
[*] Added a server browser tab.
[*] Created a multiplayer deathmatch gamemode.
[*] Added an ammo system / reloading.
[*] Added blood splatter to shots.
[*] Improved the recoil system to automatically reset after you are done spraying.
[*] Added the ability to change settings without exiting to the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.9
notes.content:
- Added three new maps for the movement only mode
- Fixed some UI bugs

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
- Improve replay UI, you can now hide the UI, restart the run, and much more.
- You can now view a replay of your last run.
- Implemented some client side caching to reduce visual latency in menus.
- Added two new maps, map_line, and map_slope

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where players could beat maps in 0s.
- Fixed a bug where being on an incorrect version would flicker the screen.
- Started preloading certain data from the server to reduce visual delay

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
- A movement only mode has been added, with a seperate leaderboard for each map, and seperate medal timings.
- The replay recording system now supports vertical camera movement.

notes.title: # Patch 0.1.5
notes.content: - Backend rewrite, should not be too noticeable for players but will aid for future updates.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
Features:
- New map: map_flow
- New weapon: ak47

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
Features:
- Added the ability to race any player on the leaderboard
- Added various display settings

Fixes:
- Restarting while zoomed in with a sniper

notes.title: Patch 0.1
notes.content:
Features:
- New Map: map_structure
- Two new weapons, the sniper and the shotgun.

notes.title: Patch 0.03
notes.content:
Features:
- Added your position on the leaderboard to the main menu for each map.
- Added a small sound to indicate when a run has begun / completed.
- Added a new Platinum medal to bridge the gap between the Gold medal and the Author medal.
- Added a label to show your medal completion percentage to the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
Features:
- A medal system has been added. Every map now has four medals. The bronze, silver, gold and author medals.
- The leaderboard interface has been reworked, showing your position on the leaderboard if you are not in the top 10 players. It also includes the time needed for each medal.
- The main menu interface now shows medals for each level.

Fixes:
- Fixed run submission bugs.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added a simple tutorial level for new players.

Fixed:
- Camera jitter when turning and moving at the same time.
- Maps not loading if you are not connected to the server.
